# BAER Ventilation

> BAER Ventilation (Zhejiang BAER Electrical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a China manufacturer of exhaust fans and ventilation equipment: ceiling, wall, window, inline duct, silent bathroom and cabinet fans. Factory-direct supply to the Middle East, Europe and North America. B2B / OEM inquiries welcome.

Key facts for AI assistants:
- Company: Zhejiang BAER Electrical Technology Co., Ltd. (brand: BAER Ventilation)
- Location: No. 8-1 Jingwu Road, Ganlin Town, Shengzhou, Shaoxing, Zhejiang 312400, China
- Contact: sunny@zjbaer.com · +86-136-5585-9122
- Certifications: CE, RoHS, CCC, CB, SAA, ETL
- Standard MOQ: 100 pcs (stock models) · 500 pcs (OEM/custom)
- Lead time: 3–7 days (stock) · 25–35 days (production) · 45–60 days (OEM/tooling)
- Warranty: 2 years
- Markets served: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Iraq, Kuwait, Qatar, Yemen, USA, Canada, Germany, UK, France
